A PIXEL COURTYARD BY LEO CHAI

Little World

A little garden. A busy workshop.
Come sit for a while.

An afternoon in the courtyard
Illustration · Bundled fixture

A watered garden. A repaired seat. Lunch together.

The three residents have gathered at the table.

This is the completed still. Follow the three moments below.

Small things, coming together

Three fictional adult residents. One shared afternoon.

First, a small snag

The empty watering can changes nothing. The gardener goes to the well, refills it, and returns.

From garden to kitchen

The garden is watered. The cook gathers existing herbs for lunch while the maker repairs a loose stool.

A place to share it

The repaired stool joins the table, lunch is served, and all three residents gather. An authored illustration, with no live simulation or model calls.

LEO CHAI 的像素庭院

小小世界

一方花园，一间工坊。
忙完了，就一起坐下来吧。

庭院里的午后
示意场景 · 内置示例

浇好的花园，修好的座位，一起吃午餐。

三位居民都来到了餐桌旁。

这是完成后的静态场景。下方按顺序展示三个片段。

小事，慢慢连在一起

三位虚构的成年居民，共度一个午后。

先遇到一个小问题

空水壶没有浇出水。园丁去井边打水，再回到香草地。

从花园到厨房

香草地浇好了。厨师采下长成的香草做午餐，手艺人则修好松动的凳子。

一起坐下来

修好的凳子搬到了桌旁，午餐上桌，三位居民聚在一起。这是编排的示意场景，没有实时模拟或模型调用。

这个世界是怎样做的
